title: On selecting big mesh instance editor crashes because of editor cache
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in 4.7dev2 ### System information Godot v4.7.dev2 - Artix Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Tue, 20 Jan 2026 22:00:13 +0000 on Tty - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (nvidia; 580.119.02) - AMD Ryzen 5 2600 Six-Core Processor (12 threads) - 31.28 GiB memory ### Issue description I have a scene, and when I select the floor mesh (quad mesh 2000x1x2000), the editor crashes with the following error: ``` ERROR: Condition "err != VK_SUCCESS" is true. Returning: FAILED at: fence_wait (drivers/vulkan/rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp:2963) ERROR: Printing last known breadcrumbs in reverse order (last executed first). Some of them might be inaccurate. Try running with --accurate-breadcrumbs for precise information. at: print_lost_device_info (drivers/vulkan/rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp:6931) ERROR: Searching last breadcrumb. We've sent up to ID: 1280 ERROR: Last breadcrumb ID found: 1278 ERROR: Last known breadcrumb: BLIT_PASS ERROR: Last known breadcrumb: UI_PASS ERROR: Last known breadcrumb: BLIT_PASS ERROR: Last known breadcrumb: UI_PASS ERROR: Last known breadcrumb: SKY_PASS ERROR: Last known breadcrumb: BLIT_PASS ERROR: Last known breadcrumb: UI_PASS ERROR: Last known breadcrumb: BLIT_PASS =================== handle_crash: Program crashed with signal 11 Engine version: Godot Engine v4.7.dev2.official (778cf54dabd8a9e25b698a87036ab8604183f303) Dumping the backtrace. You can even see on the video that it does succesfully select it, it's just that some signal/hook after which goes wrong. I assume Path3D Gizmo? I use NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti, but I never had such a problem with 4.4dev4 which I use daily, then again, I don't use Path3D there in case it's related. The MRP I attach is by deleting the `import` and `shader_cache` .godot folder. As it seems `editor` folder is the problem. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Open the MRP 2. Select the floor ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [47crash-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26090748/47crash-mrp.zip)
